* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Character: Death Star Gunner, A New Hope, C1
|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brian Kallenbach]

This Imperial is the best character in the game, but only if you are planning on blowing away systems. The [[Death Star Gunner]] adds tremendous amount to a [[Commence Primary Ignition]] destiny draw, especially when you get three on the table. Unfortunately, though, they really can't stand up to much punishment, so a few other Imperials are in order. [[Officer Evax]] and [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] are ideal, especially with the Conference Room on the table. Septoid droids also work well, providing their immense forfeit.

Combos:

[[Death Star Gunner]] + [[R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix){{!}}R3-T6]] -- Get your [[Death Star]] moving faster than ever before. Use the Gunner to go and get your [[Superlaser]], and then deploy [[R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix){{!}}R3-T6]] and head out for Yavin or [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]]. [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]], if you have a few turns, is also ideal, with the many decks focusing around that planet these days.
|pulls=* [[Superlaser]]
